faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar XF 2.0 use?
faqLeft.a: The XF 2.0 uses the Ford EcoBoost 2.0 — a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine. It was fitted to the X250 generation from 2007 to 2015.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar XF 2.0 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £1,900. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my XF 2.0?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact EcoBoost 2.0 spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild Ford EcoBoost 2.0 XF engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We rebuild the 2.0-litre EcoBoost petrol engine to original specification, replacing worn or damaged components as standard.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used XF 2.0 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my XF 2.0 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an XF 2.0 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most XF 2.0 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
